1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Industri Perkhidmatan Air (Kadar Perkhidmatan Bekalan Air)

(Negeri Terengganu) 2022.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Ogos 2022.

Kadar perkhidmatan bekalan air

2. Kadar perkhidmatan bekalan air bagi negeri Terengganu hendaklah sebagaimana

yang ditetapkan dalam Jadual Pertama.

Jenis penggunaan

3. Jenis penggunaan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama hendaklah sebagaimana

yang diperihalkan dalam Jadual Kedua.

WATER SERVICES INDUSTRY ACT 2006

WATER SERVICES INDUSTRY (RATES FOR WATER SUPPLY SERVICES)

(STATE OF TERENGGANU) REGULATIONS 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 84(2)(a) and 179(i) of the

Water Services Industry Act 2006 [Act 655], the Minister, on the recommendation of the

Commission, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Water Services Industry

(Rates for Water Supply Services) (State of Terengganu) Regulations 2022.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 August 2022.

Rates for water supply services

2. The rates for water supply for the state of Terengganu shall be as prescribed in

the First Schedule.

Type of use

3. The type of use as specified in the First Schedule shall be as described in the

Second Schedule.
